limitations: Per-metric verdicts are Holm-corrected across the metrics audited together, and the correction is recorded on each verdict; a claim that did not survive reads INCONCLUSIVE with its uncorrected p-value retained. The identical-representation rate compares strings literally, not semantically, so it under-reports agreement between the arms.
The verdict holds at this budget only (600000 evaluations across all seeds) and does not transfer to another.
